empty.title: Your profile is built by playing
empty.subtitle: Every decision in the TradeScaleX games feeds your profile: skills, strengths, weaknesses, biases. The more you play, the better the system understands how you trade, and recommends what to work on.

descriptions.discipline: Turning down mediocre setups, waiting for the right opportunities.
descriptions.lecture_marche: Identifying direction and HTF context correctly.
descriptions.gestion_risque: Placing stops at distances consistent with structure.
descriptions.timing: Choosing the right entry moment, not too early, not too late.
descriptions.liquidite: Recognizing sweeps, traps and liquidity-hunt zones.
descriptions.structure: Reading swings, supports, resistances and key levels.
descriptions.execution: Accounting for spread, session and volatility.
descriptions.patience: Waiting for confirmations and letting trades run.
descriptions.rr_management: Optimizing the risk/reward ratio of each trade.

discipline.name: Disciplined trader
discipline.description: You know when not to trade. Your patience and respect for risk are your strengths. Keep filtering out mediocre setups.

impulsif.name: Impulsive trader
impulsif.description: You take too many trades without conviction. You react instead of waiting. Work on patience and discipline.

structure_reader.name: Strong structure reader
structure_reader.description: You identify key levels, swings and HTF zones well. Now work on execution and R/R to turn that read into an edge.

aggressive.name: Overly aggressive trader
aggressive.description: You read the market correctly but take too much risk per trade. Your stops are tight, your R/R is poorly managed, your capital suffers.

risk_manager.name: Strong risk manager
risk_manager.description: You place your stops at consistent distances and your R/R is solid. Next step: sharpen your reading to multiply good opportunities.

breakout_hunter.name: Breakout hunter
breakout_hunter.description: You take breakouts with conviction. Beware of fakeouts, the liquidity above/below levels is your enemy.

emotional.name: Emotional trader
emotional.description: Revenge trades and FOMO cost you dearly. Your emotional decisions weigh on your performance. A break after 2 stops in a row would change everything.

patient.name: Patient trader
patient.description: You wait for the right setups, you don't force anything. Keep cultivating this quality, it's the long-term trader's #1 weapon.

analyst_no_executor.name: Good analyst, poor execution
analyst_no_executor.description: You read the market correctly, but spread, session and timing ruin your trades. Technique alone isn't enough, execution is part of the edge.

liquidity_aware.name: Liquidity reader
liquidity_aware.description: You spot sweeps and anticipate institutional traps. Combine this skill with better R/R to turn this edge into performance.

neutral.name: Developing trader
neutral.description: Not enough signals yet to identify a dominant profile. Keep playing, alternating games and levels, and your profile will sharpen.
